{{Top|leg}}
[[File:The_Hat.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[K'Kruhk]], wearing his hat]]
{{Quote|See? It's a hat.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A '''hat''' or '''cap''' was an article of clothing that was placed upon the head. It served several purposes, such as protection and for show.<ref name="EotE">[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

Hats also served to disguise the cranial structure if it were to draw unwanted attention, such as the large conical hat that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] wore while on a mission to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="outlander">''[[Star Wars: Outlander]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] was seen, on many occasions, wearing a large hat.<ref name="Republic63">[[Republic 63|''Republic'' 63]]</ref> Two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], also wore hats.<ref name="TCW">{{TCW|Bounty Hunters}}</ref> They could also be used to conceal items. [[Nico Okarr]] used his hat to conceal a data-slicing kit.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
